# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue, discussion,
or pull request.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form:

https://github.com/Chunky83/jev-workbench/security/advisories/new

Include the affected version, the expected and observed behavior, reproduction
steps, potential impact, and any suggested mitigation. Remove API keys,
authorization data, customer identifiers, private files, and unrelated personal
information before submitting a report.

Reports are reviewed on a best-effort basis. This project does not currently
operate a bug-bounty program or guarantee a response or remediation schedule.
Please allow reasonable time for investigation before public disclosure.

## Scope

Reports about Jev Workbench source code, packaged applications, connector
boundaries, build automation, and release artifacts are in scope.

Do not access data that is not your own, disrupt services, perform high-volume
testing, or use social engineering while investigating a report. Vulnerabilities
in third-party services should be reported to the service owner unless Jev
Workbench introduces the vulnerability through its integration.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest published version when practical.
Preview builds and older versions may require upgrading to receive a fix.
